_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 07 (re-picked after the first draft was overtaken): 2024-08-08 to 2024-09-19. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He argues money is needed to pay off churches and spread the gospel, and says many will hear directly what to do in the days ahead as they enter a new season.
mentions.quote: there will be a lot of you that will hear him on what to do
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an appeal, no observable claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says there is another blood moon at Rosh Hashanah this year, that the Lord called this one supernatural, and that something is going to happen on 3 October which is a turning point and the tipping point.
mentions.quote: There is something that is going to be on the 3rd of October
mentions.falsify_match: An event of turning-point significance on or about 3 October 2024.

mentions.claim_text: He says supernatural manifestations of the glory are coming and that God is about to give a second wind to those who feel like giving up.
mentions.quote: God's about to give you a second wind
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: encouragement, no observable criterion.

mentions.claim_text: He says the great wells are being uncapped and urges believing for healing now rather than waiting for Rosh Hashanah on 3 October.
mentions.quote: the great the great wells are being uncapped
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: no observable criterion for wells being uncapped.

mentions.claim_text: Closing prayer of thanks resting on the promise that those who abide and whose words remain in him may ask what they will.
mentions.quote: if ye abide in me and my words abide in may remain in you
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: intercession.

mentions.claim_text: He relays a question from someone told by the Holy Spirit not to invest in gold and silver, and answers that if the Spirit said not to, then do not, adding that this is what has been told to certain people.
mentions.quote: about investing in gold and silver, but the Lord told me not to do it
mentions.falsify_match: Sits against his own standing counsel to hold physical gold and silver; recorded because the two are in tension.

mentions.claim_text: He recounts asking for an unmistakable sign, four inches of rain in one night, saying he would step out in faith if it came, and that on 5 July it rained.
mentions.quote: If you make it 4 in of rain in one night, I'll know it's you
mentions.condition_text: he set the condition himself as a fleece
mentions.falsify_match: Rainfall records for his location on 5 July would settle it.
mentions.falsify_miss: The records show a different total.

mentions.claim_text: He says it measured exactly four inches, that he photographed it with food colouring added as a memorial, and took it as the sign to step out in faith.
mentions.quote: It was It was It was It was 4 in. Four inches
mentions.falsify_match: The photograph and local rainfall data are both in principle checkable.

mentions.claim_text: He says miracles like nothing seen before are about to take place, beginning from Rosh Hashanah to Rosh Hashanah as the start of the glorious outpouring, first the blade, then the ear, then the full manifestation.
mentions.quote: Starting from Roash Shana to Roash Sha, he said the beginning of the glorious outpouring
mentions.falsify_match: A widely recognised outpouring across that year.
mentions.falsify_miss: None, though the staged framing absorbs a slow start.

mentions.claim_text: Teaching that expectation brings the manifestation, so believers should expect something huge and supernatural rather than believing for small things.
mentions.quote: Expectation brings the manifestation of what you've been believing for
mentions.condition_text: outcome conditioned on the hearer's expectation
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: the expectation clause absorbs any non-arrival.

mentions.claim_text: He tells viewers to learn to hear for themselves because there may not be a YouTube or an internet soon, and asks what they would do if all the prophetic voices there went silent.
mentions.quote: there may not be a YouTube soon. There may not be an internet soon
mentions.falsify_match: Loss or heavy restriction of internet access in the US.
mentions.falsify_miss: The internet stays available, though soon is undefined.

mentions.claim_text: He urges taking salvation today because tomorrow is not promised, retelling the Lord asking whether he comprehends eternity and telling him to count the stars as years.
mentions.quote: Do you have a comprehension of eternity, Brandon?
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an appeal.

mentions.claim_text: He says that back in April, before COVID, the Lord told him he was sending another plague and that cataclysmic things were going to happen, telling him to know that it was him.
mentions.quote: the Lord told me that he was sending another uh plague
mentions.falsify_match: A second pandemic-scale outbreak.

mentions.claim_text: He says the shaking coming is not judgment but correction, sent to awaken people so their hearts are right before the Lord comes.
mentions.quote: this is not going to be judgment this is a this is correction
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: the distinction between judgment and correction is not observable.

mentions.claim_text: He says he has an urgency to keep beating the drum that a storm is coming, and states outright that he does not know whether it comes this year.
mentions.quote: warning you that a storm is coming is it coming this year I don't know
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable as stated: he removes the date himself.

mentions.claim_text: Standard sign off with a blessing.
mentions.quote: may the Lord keep you may his face shine upon you
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: sign off.

mentions.claim_text: Opening remarks describing himself as a prophetic intercessor with a tight relationship with the Lord who tries to let viewers in on what he sees.
mentions.quote: as a prophetic uh intercessor I I see a lot
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: framing.

mentions.claim_text: The Lord tells him not to give up on 2024 with five months left, to believe for big and for even greater works still in 2024, calling it a time of fire and great acceleration in which they will soar.
mentions.quote: Brandon, don't give up on 2024 yet. Believe me for big
mentions.falsify_match: A visible acceleration in the last months of 2024.
mentions.falsify_miss: None, absorbed by the belief condition.

mentions.claim_text: He says what will save America is an awakening unto God and a great revival, getting back to fundamentals in church, and not Trump or a new Congress.
mentions.quote: That's what's going to save America. Not Trump
mentions.falsify_match: A national religious revival precedes any recovery.
mentions.falsify_miss: Recovery comes politically without revival, or neither comes.

mentions.claim_text: He reads another man's 2018 visitation account saying Jesus is coming, and remarks on how far along things are now compared with then.
mentions.quote: He had this visitation in 2018, folks
mentions.falsify_match: Not his claim; corroboration he reads on air.

mentions.claim_text: Teaching that thankfulness for even the smallest thing, being able to move your eyes when paralysed, is the open door to greater blessing.
mentions.quote: that's the the key of the open door for the greater blessings
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: teaching with a gratitude condition.

mentions.claim_text: Testimony that after being laid off by a church whose finances dried up, they made more between May and September than they had earned working for it.
mentions.quote: we had made more than what we had made working for the church
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: private household finances.

mentions.claim_text: In a vision he saw spoken words stay alive like seeds in front of your face, never dying, growing and putting down roots.
mentions.quote: the words would stay alive and they would become uh like alive
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a picture of how speech works spiritually.

mentions.claim_text: He mentions being able to attend church as a family without disruption and announces a prayer conference in Branson, Missouri in October.
mentions.quote: they're having a prayer conference in Branson Missouri
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: event announcement.

mentions.claim_text: He describes seeing a figure unable to stand in the presence of God, melting down and bowed because he turned his back on the King of Kings, with principalities and darkness behind him.
mentions.quote: he could not stand the presence of God he was melting down
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an unnamed figure in a spiritual scene.

mentions.claim_text: He gives the conference dates as 16 to 21 October, about two months away, and recommends it for the fall colours as well as the teaching.
mentions.quote: it's October the 16th to like the 21st
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: event announcement.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats the October dates for the Missouri conference and describes the teaching on prayer, the blood and getting into the glory.
mentions.quote: October the 16th to the 21st her conference is coming
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: event announcement.

mentions.claim_text: He plays a source who was accurate two weeks earlier now saying the next attack will be on the United States power grid, and notes many articles saying the grid is extremely vulnerable to cyber attack.
mentions.quote: the next attack now everybody pay attention is going to be the power grid
mentions.falsify_match: A cyber attack on the US grid.

mentions.claim_text: He summarises the warning as an attack on the power grid between August and the elections, affecting certain cities, and says it matches what he has seen.
mentions.quote: attacking the power grid from August to the elections some certain cities
mentions.falsify_match: A grid attack in named US cities before the November 2024 election.

mentions.claim_text: He describes the United States economy as a dam that is starting to get stress cracks and break, with putrid sludge leaking out through the cracks.
mentions.quote: that dam is starting to get stress cracks and starting to break
mentions.falsify_match: Visible structural failure in the US economy.

mentions.claim_text: He says 2025 has the potential to be a very dark year, that he has seen a great storm coming after the elections, and repeats that something will take place in October, while allowing that things can change in the spirit.
mentions.quote: 2025 has the potential to be a very dark year
mentions.condition_text: he adds that if things change in the spirit he does not know
mentions.falsify_match: 2025 is marked by crisis on the scale he describes.

mentions.claim_text: Reading a warning from another source about places of refuge and supernatural protection, he passes on that riots igniting racism will begin in places beyond Missouri once food and water become harder to get.
mentions.quote: Riot igniting racism will begin in other places than just Missouri
mentions.time_phrase: when food and water become harder to get
mentions.falsify_match: Race riots spreading from Missouri amid food and water shortages.

mentions.claim_text: He passes on another warning to pray for the protection of Israel and especially Tel Aviv, where an attempted chemical attack was seen in a vision that day.
mentions.quote: I saw an attempted chemical attack there in a vision today
mentions.falsify_match: An attempted chemical attack on Tel Aviv.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a vision of pure Holy Ghost fire camp meetings with women in buns and without makeup, reading it as a separation unto God rather than a dress rule.
mentions.quote: I saw the buns and the no makeup
mentions.falsify_match: A revival movement marked by visible separatist practice.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is biblical to bring three witnesses and names three people he trusts who are hearing something is coming, tells viewers to be ready, and says he has not heard directly when, only that he sees something about 2025.
mentions.quote: I see something about 2025 does that mean it's g
mentions.falsify_match: A major crisis in 2025 matching what the three warned of.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is telling people to pray about October, that he is hearing more and more voices warning by the Spirit, and that a great storm is coming for which they must be ready.
mentions.quote: a great storm is coming and I'm telling you all it's time
mentions.falsify_match: A crisis beginning in October 2024.

mentions.claim_text: He tells viewers that if they will not get into the word then they should not watch his videos, because the word is priority over him or anyone on the prophetic network.
mentions.quote: get in the word then don't watch my video get in the word
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: exhortation, and a rare instance of pointing away from himself.

mentions.claim_text: Teaching that he refuses to let a rock do his job of praising, since everything that has breath should praise regardless of circumstances.
mentions.quote: I refuse to let a rock do my job
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: teaching.

mentions.claim_text: A first person word promising provision for those separated to him, with the note that those seeking him daily rather than only on Sunday will hear whether to relocate, tied to the big migrations he saw of people leaving major cities.
mentions.quote: I saw big migrations of people TR going from place to place leaving major cit
mentions.condition_text: hearing about relocation conditioned on seeking him daily
mentions.falsify_match: Large scale movement out of major US cities.

mentions.claim_text: He says the things he prophesied are trying to manifest, naming biological material he saw coming out of a cave in Iran, chemicals to be sprayed on people somehow, as a secret attack like the one in October.
mentions.quote: the biological stuff that I saw coming out of a a cave in Iran
mentions.falsify_match: A chemical or biological attack traced to Iran.
